name: notfair_plugin
description: Provides open-source SEO, geographic (GEO), and marketing skill modules designed for integration with AI agents to enhance their capabilities in search engine optimization, location-based services, and marketing strategies.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: User search query or marketing-related request for generating SEO or GEO optimized responses.

inputs.name: location_data
inputs.description: Geographic information such as coordinates, region, or address to tailor GEO-based marketing or SEO results.

inputs.name: marketing_parameters
inputs.description: Parameters or constraints relating to marketing objectives like target audience, campaign goals, or channels.

outputs.name: optimized_content
outputs.description: SEO and marketing optimized textual content tailored for target geography and marketing goals.

outputs.name: geo_targeting_data
outputs.description: Geographically contextualized data or recommendations for effective marketing and SEO application.

outputs.name: performance_metrics
outputs.description: Analytical metrics or insights related to SEO effectiveness, marketing reach, or GEO targeting impact.

steps: Receive user input containing search queries and marketing parameters
Extract and interpret geographic location data if provided
Apply SEO optimization techniques tailored to the query and location
Generate marketing content or recommendations based on parameters and GEO context
Return optimized content and GEO-targeted data to AI agent for further response generation
use_cases: Enhancing AI-driven chatbots to provide SEO optimized content in multiple regions
Generating localized marketing campaigns for geographically targeted audiences
Improving AI recommendations by incorporating geographical and SEO best practices
Supporting SEO analysis and content creation during AI-assisted digital marketing efforts
patterns: Integration of SEO algorithms with AI agent frameworks
Modular skill interface for AI agent interaction

prompt_templates.name: seo_optimization_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Optimize the following text for SEO based on target keywords: {query}

prompt_templates.name: geo_marketing_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Create a marketing strategy tailored for the location {location_data} targeting {marketing_parameters}

prompt_templates.name: combined_seo_geo_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Generate SEO optimized content considering the geographic details: {location_data} with marketing goals: {marketing_parameters}
